name: vision-studios-site
description: Vision Studios website: static generator + WordPress theme, both fed by content pulled from vision-studios.net

scripts.theme:css: cd wordpress && npx -y tailwindcss@3.4.17 -c tailwind.config.js -i tailwind.input.css -o vision-studios-theme/assets/app.css --minify
scripts.theme:zip: npm run theme:import-data && npm run theme:css && cd wordpress && rm -f vision-studios-theme.zip && zip -qr vision-studios-theme.zip vision-studios-theme -x '*.DS_Store' && ls -la vision-studios-theme.zip
scripts.wp:import: cd wordpress && docker compose run --rm --entrypoint sh cli -c 'php -d memory_limit=1024M /usr/local/bin/wp vs import --posts'
